title: ACT ON NATIONAL HOLIDAYS
full_text:
Article 1 (Designation of National Holidays)
National holidays shall be designated to commemorate days of national celebration.

Article 2 (Types of National Holidays)
The national holidays shall be as follows:
1. Independence Movement Day: March 1.
2. Constitution Day: July 17.
3. National Liberation Day: August 15.
4. National Foundation Day: October 3.
5. Hangeul Day: October 9.

Article 3 Deleted. <December 30, 2014>

ADDENDUM <Act No. 53, October 1, 1949>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
